messages:
Maya: Hey team — kicking off onboarding for HelioAI. Quick sync to align stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, risks, and enablement. I’ll capture actions.
Luis: Congrats! Quick stakeholder list: Sam (product), Dr. Chen (ML eng), Nora (security), Felix (procurement).
Sam: Hi all — Sam here. Primary goal: embed chat on storefront + FAQ reranker. Targets: median latency <100ms, cost < $0.75 / 1k tokens, EU data residency.
Priya: I’ll own sandbox & infra. Need AD group list, SSO SAML cert, and a small sample dataset. ETA to provision sandbox: 3 business days after access.
Jonas: Solutions note — propose starting with a quantized 13B variant for initial perf tests, fallback to hosted tiny model for spikes. Please send sample prompts and expected QPS.
Maya: Success criteria proposal: 1) sandbox provisioned and integration docs complete, 2) integration passes perf & correctness smoke tests, 3) two enablement sessions delivered and runbook handed off, 4) customer NPS >= 7 post-enable, 5) renewal risk rated low. Suggest a 6-week cadence.
Sam: 6 weeks works. Top dependencies: SSO, signed MSA, and PCI scan clearance (they process card tokens).
Nora: Security asks: network diagram + dataflow, confirmation of logs retention policy, KMS key access pattern. Also need to validate ingress IPs for VPC peering.
Priya: Enablement plan: 2x 60min workshops (integration + tuning) + one open office-hours drop-in. Deliverables: runbook, snags doc, quickstart script.
Maya: Proposed schedule: 
```text
Week 0: legal sign & SSO config
Week 1: sandbox provisioning & smoke tests
Week 2: ingestion + perf baseline
Week 3: enablement sessions + sample tuning
Week 4-5: iterate, QA, regression tests
Week 6: handoff + metrics review + NPS
```
Luis: I’ll track the epic in Jira: RD-8452 (onboarding). Link: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RD-8452
Sam: We’ll deliver sample dataset and prompt library by Friday EOD.
Maya: Major risks: procurement delays, SSO cert turnaround, model perf gap vs expectation. Mitigations: temporary hosted fallback, weekly gating call, and early perf smoke.
Jonas: I’ll check perf with a smoke script — example: `scripts/perf_smoke.sh --tokens 1000 --concurrency 4` and share results.
Priya: Need cross-account IAM role for sandbox access. @Luis can you confirm who provides that?
Luis: Yep, I’ll create a cross-account role and share ARN + instructions by EOD.
Maya: Feedback capture plan: 1) short survey after enablement, 2) weekly short sync notes, 3) collection of prompt-level quality examples into a shared doc for model tuning.
Sam: Fine with that. Also request a short internal training playbook for their support reps.
Nora: +1 on training. I’ll add a security checklist item to the runbook template.
Maya: Action items summarized — I’ll send calendar invites and the onboarding epic link. If no objections, we’ll kick tomorrow at 9am PT. :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup: good to go
Luis: +1
Nora: +1
Priya: Ready, thanks!
